thread:
morgan: Quick idea for deep-links to moved items: instead of only a small pill, what if we show a transient "context ribbon" at the top of the console that reads the original path and the canonical place, with a single "Open migration helper" action. Less buried than a tooltip.

tara: I like a ribbon for visibility. Keep it non-modal, low-contrast, and dismissible. One-shot per user. Copy: "This link resolved to a moved item: Workspaces > Models → Assets > Models. Open migration helper?"

devin: Router-wise we still resolve via alias table. Implementation note: show ribbon only when route was resolved via alias. Pseudo: `if (resolvedByAlias) showRibbon({from: oldPath, to: canonicalPath})`

alex: UX: ribbon should show canonical breadcrumb plus a subtle action: "Open migration helper" that opens a drawer with a list of affected bookmarks. Also log metrics for ribbon shown/clicked and helper opened.

sam: A11y: ribbon must be keyboard reachable, focusable, and aria-live polite for the announcement. Drawer should trap focus when open and restore focus to the ribbon button when closed. Color contrast >=4.5:1 for text.

deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled: 2024-11-30 04:15 UTC

morgan: Nice. I'll wire up the mock and spec the alias JSON shape for infra: `[{"pattern":"/workspaces/:wid/models/:mid","canonical":"/assets/models/:mid","orgToggle":false}]`. Will open PR and assign tasks.
